subject: microbiology
title: Disinfectant Testing: Rideal-Walker, Chick-Martin and Biological Indicators

steps.tx: The **Rideal Walker test** grades a disinfectant against phenol itself: dilutions of test agent and phenol are challenged with Salmonella Typhi for set times at set temperature, subcultured, and the ratio of the weakest effective test dilution to phenol's is the phenol coefficient (above 1 beats phenol). It ignores organic matter and other organisms, which is precisely its historical limitation and its examination point.
steps.say: Phenol coefficient above one beats phenol, in clean water, against one organism only.

left.title: Rideal Walker method
points: Coefficient: test dilution over phenol dilution

steps.tx: The **Chick Martin test** repairs Rideal Walker's cleanliness by adding organic matter (dried faeces or yeast suspension) to the challenge, giving coefficients nearer ward reality and usually lower. Modern successors (capacity and suspension tests, EN and ASTM standards, in use dilution confirmations) extend the same scepticism: a disinfectant is only its tested conditions, organism panel and contact time.
steps.say: Add dirt and coefficients fall; modern standards test the conditions of actual use.

left.title: Chick Martin repair
points: Organic load in the test mixture

right.title: Modern testing
points: In use dilution and capacity tests

steps.tx: **Geobacillus stearothermophilus** (formerly Bacillus stearothermophilus) spores are moist heat's biological indicator because this thermophile's spores resist steam more than any pathogen's, grow at 55 to 60 degrees where contaminants rest, and announce failure by growth and colour change after the cycle. Bacillus atrophaeus spores referee dry heat and ethylene oxide with the same logic in different armour.
steps.say: The indicator organism is chosen to be harder to kill than anything the load could carry.

left.title: Indicator pairings
points: Dry heat and EtO: B atrophaeus (subtilis group)
Self contained ampoules with growth medium

right.title: Reading discipline
points: Positive result quarantines loads back to last negative
Implant loads quarantined until result where policy demands

steps.tx: **Chemical indicators speak** in classes worth one clean pass: external tape (exposure only), single variable strips, multi variable integrators tracking time temperature and steam, and emulating indicators tuned to specific cycles, the Bowie Dick test daily proving air removal and steam penetration in prevacuum sterilisers before loads run. Colour change is exposure evidence, never sterility itself.
steps.say: Integrators approach the spore's testimony; tape merely proves the pack travelled.

left.title: Indicator classes
points: Class 3 and 4: single and multi variable

right.title: Bowie Dick
points: Failure stops the steriliser, not the paperwork
Leaks and vacuum faults detected early

steps.tx: **Sterility testing of** finished products (pharmacopoeial membrane filtration or direct inoculation into aerobic, anaerobic and fungal media for fourteen days) samples statistically and can never prove every unit, which is why parametric release by validated processes replaced end product testing wherever regulators allow. The indicator philosophy of this lesson scales: process proof beats product sampling.
steps.say: You cannot test sterility into a batch; you validate it in and sample for reassurance.

left.title: Sterility testing
points: Thioglycollate and soybean casein media pair

right.title: Parametric philosophy
points: End product tests as final audit

steps.tx: **Disinfectant failure investigation** follows the test logic backwards: wrong dilution (concentration strips), expired or topped up solutions, contact time shortened, organic load uncleaned, organism outside spectrum (spores, naked viruses, mycobacteria), and water quality diluting actives. Each failure mode maps to one variable the standard tests isolate, which is why the old tests still teach troubleshooting.
steps.say: Every disinfection failure is one test variable violated in the wild.

nodes.label: Cleaning, contact time and dilution practice audited

steps.tx: **Susceptibility of microbes** to disinfectants descends a resistance ladder worth memorising as one image: prions above spores, spores above mycobacteria (waxy walls), naked viruses and protozoan cysts mid ladder, fungi and vegetative bacteria below, enveloped viruses most fragile at the base. Selecting an agent is choosing a rung and paying its contact time.
steps.say: Prions, spores, mycobacteria, naked viruses, bacteria, enveloped viruses: pick your rung.

left.title: Hard to kill
points: Naked viruses and cysts: variable resistance

steps.tx: **Examination pairing closes** the sterilisation module: Rideal Walker (phenol coefficient, clean, Typhi), Chick Martin (organic matter), stearothermophilus (steam biological), Bowie Dick (air removal), phosphatase (pasteurisation), MEC strips (glutaraldehyde in use). Each test guards one variable, and viva questions ask which guard was asleep in a described failure.
steps.say: Match each test to the variable it guards and sterilisation vivas answer themselves.

left.title: Test to variable
points: Rideal Walker and Chick Martin: potency
